name: GFX_hof_ic_khrushchev_the_virgin_lands
title: 处女地
concept: A flat unfolded neutral-gray inland MAP on a desk, with its eastern half almost BLANK and unmarked; no identifiable coastlines, Crimea, Black Sea or place names. ONE metal pushpin is planted on the blank east. Exactly beneath the pin on the paper lies a small rough PINCH OF BROWN SOIL, tactile crumbs pressing into the map. Cool and somber, soil-brown the only modest central accent. No tractor, farm tools, people, wheat, flags or legible text.
